beats.say: A brand just messaged you. Before you get excited, check for these five warning signs.
One: a brand ambassador manager messages you out of nowhere. Two: they flatter your page and style.

msgs: Hi! I manage brand ambassadors for a big brand.
Your style is amazing! You're perfect for us!

beats.say: Three: they drop names of real people at the company. Four: they send links that only look official.

msgs: Our marketing director picked you herself.

beats.say: Five, the big one: they ask for your bank or personal details, so payments can start.
To check, call the brand on a number you already know is real, never one they sent. And never share bank details in a DM.
